s.note: Beef, cheese and pickle sliders on soft buns. Two out of three branches still working.
s.how: Roll the mince into 8 balls and season well. Smash them flat on a very hot griddle, scatter with onion and cook 2 minutes, then flip and add cheese. Toast the buns, then add the patties, pickles, mustard and sauce.

s.n: Head-popping green pea and mint soup shots
s.note: Bright green pea soup with a mint cream swirl. Slim Whitman pops the Martian heads.
s.how: Soften the onion in the butter. Add the peas and stock, simmer for 5 minutes, then blend with most of the mint until very smooth. Blend the rest of the mint into the cream with a squeeze of lemon. Pour the hot soup into shot glasses and swirl the mint cream on top.

m.note: Slow-roast rib of beef with jus and horseradish. Art Land opens the Galaxy in Vegas.
m.how: Rub the beef with salt, pepper, garlic and rosemary and sit it on a rack in a roasting tin. Roast at 120C until the centre reads 52C for medium-rare. Toss the potatoes with oil and salt and roast them alongside for the last hour. Rest the beef, then blast it at 250C for 10 minutes to crisp the fat. Deglaze the tin with the stock for a jus and carve at the table with horseradish.

m.n: King Tut lamb with saffron rice, no pork
m.note: Spiced lamb shoulder, saffron rice and yoghurt. Byron works the floor dressed as King Tut.
m.how: Rub the lamb with the spices, garlic and salt. Sit it on the onions in a lidded pot, add the stock and braise at 160C until it pulls apart. Soak the saffron in 2 tbsp hot water, then cook the rice with it in salted water. Pull the lamb, spoon over the juices and serve with the rice, yoghurt and mint.

w.n: International sign of the donut glazed rings
w.note: Warm yeast donuts in a lime-green glaze. Richie's dad is ready to lock and load.
w.how: Mix the flour, yeast, sugar, milk, egg, butter and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and knead until smooth, then prove until doubled. Roll out 1cm thick and cut rings with a large and small cutter. Fry at 170C for about a minute a side until golden, then drain. Whisk the icing sugar with the lime zest and juice and dip the warm donuts.

d.n: It's Not Unusual green apple sour
d.note: Vodka, green apple, lime and a fizz of soda. Tom Jones is on in the showroom.
d.how: Shake the vodka, apple juice, lime juice and syrup hard with ice. Strain into 4 glasses over fresh ice and top with a splash of soda.
